My name is Harald Kliems. I like bikes, cities, health, data, maps.

# More information

I’m co-founder and board member of the local bike advocacy non-profit [Madison Bikes](https://www.madisonbikes.org/), I work at the [University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health](https://prc.wisc.edu/), I contribute to [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/user/hobbesvsboyle). I'm on the City of Madison Transportation Commission and the Board of Public Works. I have a nerdy and infrequently updated [bike blog](http://ride-or-pie.netlify.app/).

All opinions here are my own.
